classification: confirmed native WebKit limitation; not Field production defect
resolution: Record the browser limitation without a Field compatibility workaround, as selected by the user on 2026-10-03. Retain the reproduction and keep the affected requirement partial.
reproduction: Valid plain native form > outer disabled fieldset > inner disabled fieldset > first legend > input, inner fieldset outside outer first legend. No Solid/Field adapter and no fieldset within legend.
findings: Chromium/Firefox inner-first :disabled=true, programmatic focus blocked, willValidate=false, omitted FormData, skipped trusted Tab.
WebKit inner-first :disabled=false, focus succeeds, willValidate=true, included FormData, included trusted Tab. Reproduces twice with outer disabled=true before and after toggle.
All engines behave alike with outer disabled=false; inner-body remains disabled.
Jest-dom matcher independently recursively walks fieldset ancestors and returns disabled=true for inner-first even in WebKit; its semantic algorithm does not establish effective native behavior.

matcherSource.algorithm: Recurses all ancestors; skips disabled attribute only when traversing that fieldset first direct legend, so outer disabled still applies.

proposal: Record explicit browser limitation and preserve expected platform contract and evidence. Keep universal full closure unavailable for fieldset.forms.1; if accepted, use narrowly scoped known-failure treatment only for WebKit nested first-legend scenarios. Do not add Field workaround or replace native behavior with matcher-only assertions.
scopeLimits: Browser builds used by current installed Playwright; not every Safari release.
